stable_traits.personality: Determined, conflicted about Aes Sedai, carrying burden of destiny, eager to reconnect with old friends

characters.notes: Wearing fine red coat that makes others think he's a lord. Carrying the Horn of Valere. Has herons embroidered on his collar and on his sword. Has a brand on his palm (hidden).

stable_traits.physical_traits: White hair, white mustaches, gnarled fingers, bony, old
stable_traits.filiations: Had a nephew named Owyn who could channel and was gentled by the Red Ajah
stable_traits.personality: Cautious about involvement in dangerous affairs, caring toward Dena, knowledgeable about the Old Tongue and prophecies, once played the Great Game in Caemlyn

characters.notes: Currently performing at nobles' manors in Cairhien. Living with Dena at The Bunch of Grapes. Wears a cloak with colorful patches. Has his instruments back (harp and flute). Refuses to get involved with the Horn despite being tempted.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Half again as tall as Rand, head almost brushes ceiling
stable_traits.filiations: Son of Arent son of Halan, from Stedding Shangtai
stable_traits.personality: Nervous about meeting other Ogier, anxious about having left home hastily, gentle and thoughtful

characters.notes: Fears trouble when he returns to Stedding Shangtai. Interested in playing dice. Traveling with Rand and Hurin.

stable_traits.personality: Loyal, dutiful, protective of Rand's identity

factions.name: Fal Dara
factions.notes: Serves Fal Dara as a sniffer

characters.notes: Staying at The Defender of the Dragonwall with Rand and Loial. Keeping watch while others go out. Deflecting questions from Cairhienin about their purpose.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Slender, pretty, fair Cairhienin skin, dark hair hanging loose to shoulders
stable_traits.age: Only a handful of years older than Rand (early twenties)
stable_traits.personality: Talented, ambitious to become a gleeman/bard, confident, affectionate toward Thom

characters.notes: Thom's lover and apprentice. Can juggle six balls. Has exceptional memory for tales and natural talent with harp and flute. Thom believes she will become a court-bard. Getting knives made by someone named Ivon.
Not physically present in this chapter but discussed extensively. Last saw Rand at Fal Dara. Told Rand he could go where he wanted. Authenticated the Horn of Valere.

stable_traits.personality: Restrained in using the Power, tried to help his village, went mad before being gentled

characters.notes: Dead. Could channel. Held off the madness for almost three years. Was gentled by the Red Ajah and died afterward. People in his village nearly stoned Thom when they learned he was Owyn's uncle.

stable_traits.age: Old enough to have known Thom for years
stable_traits.personality: Blunt, concerned for Thom's safety, speaks her mind freely, wise to the dangers of the Game of Houses

characters.notes: Innkeeper of The Bunch of Grapes. Has known Thom for years off and on. Warns him about the dangers of Daes Dae'mar in Cairhien. Advises him to marry Dena.
Runs a performance hall in Cairhien. Has hired Thom to perform. Recently took on a troupe of 'players' who use painted canvas backdrops, which Thom considers inferior to traditional gleeman art.
A craftsman making knives for Dena. Thom gave Dena silver coins to pay Ivon.
A Cairhienin noble. Thom is scheduled to perform for her and her guests tonight at her manor.
Not present; mentioned as someone Rand hopes will come. Rand considers Ingtar's arrival 'the best thing that could' happen next to Thom being alive.
Not present. Thom spoke with him in Caemlyn, where Gill told Thom that Rand had left in company with an Ogier.
Current King of Cairhien. Nobles scheme to gain power over him or to replace him.
Legendary hero that the 'players' pretend to be. Part of traditional gleeman tales.

Not present but mentioned by Rand who wonders where she is. Made salve that healed Rand's palm brand. Rand realizes he 'sounds like Selene' when trying to persuade Thom.
Not present but mentioned in Rand's thoughts when he thinks about Aes Sedai he doesn't want to burn.

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: The Dark One or his chief servant

characters.notes: Not present but mentioned in Rand's thoughts. Said something to Rand about dealing with channeling.
Innkeeper of The Defender of the Dragonwall. Gave Rand a startled look when he rushed through. Gender not specified but context suggests male.

appearances.whereabouts: The Defender of the Dragonwall inn in Cairhien, then The Bunch of Grapes in the Foregate
appearances.notable_actions: Rushed to his room to get Thom's instruments. Went to The Bunch of Grapes to find Thom. Told Thom about having the Horn of Valere. Asked Thom about the Karaethon Cycle and prophecies. Tried to recruit Thom to help bring the Horn to Shienar. Listened to Thom recite verses about the Dragon Reborn. Left after Thom refused to join him.
appearances.demeanor: Excited, eager, hopeful initially; becomes conflicted and evasive when discussing prophecies and his destiny; bitter about Aes Sedai but tries to hide his concerns

appearances.whereabouts: The Bunch of Grapes inn in the Foregate, Cairhien
appearances.notable_actions: Reunited with Rand. Got his flute and harp back. Complained about the 'players' Seaghan hired. Recited verses from the Karaethon Cycle for Rand. Discussed his nephew Owyn who could channel. Refused to join Rand's quest with the Horn. Gave Rand a replacement flute. Asked Rand to make a clean break and not visit again.
appearances.demeanor: Initially jovial and complaining about theatrical matters; becomes serious and knowledgeable when discussing prophecies; conflicted between temptation of the Horn and desire for stability with Dena; ultimately cautious and protective of his current life

appearances.whereabouts: The Defender of the Dragonwall, then The Bunch of Grapes with Rand, then in the common room playing dice
appearances.notable_actions: Accompanied Rand to find Thom. Expressed desire to meet Thom. Was nervous about encountering other Ogier. Left the room when Rand asked for privacy with Thom. Went to play dice in the common room.
appearances.demeanor: Eager to meet Thom, anxious about being found by other Ogier, cooperative when asked to leave

appearances.whereabouts: The Defender of the Dragonwall inn, keeping watch
appearances.notable_actions: Was keeping watch at the inn. Offered to continue watching while Rand and Loial visited Thom. Deflected questions from Cairhienin locals about their purpose.
appearances.demeanor: Dutiful, loyal, anxious about Lord Rand's safety

appearances.whereabouts: Thom's room at The Bunch of Grapes
appearances.notable_actions: Was juggling when Rand arrived. Met Rand and Loial. Kissed Thom when he returned. Was sent out by Thom to pick up knives from Ivon.
appearances.demeanor: Confident, practicing her craft, affectionate with Thom, slightly dismissive of the fine-dressed Rand initially

appearances.whereabouts: The Bunch of Grapes inn (her establishment)
appearances.notable_actions: Directed Rand to Thom's room. Later entered Thom's room to warn him about playing the Game of Houses and the dangers in Cairhien. Advised him to marry Dena.
appearances.demeanor: Direct, concerned, motherly toward Thom, disbelieving of his claims about being out of Daes Dae'mar

relationships.description: Thom was Rand's mentor and traveling companion earlier. Rand seeks his help and friendship, but Thom declines to get involved again.
Thom and Dena are lovers living together. He is training her to be a gleeman/bard. She loves him despite their age difference.
Traveling companions and friends working together to return the Horn to Shienar.
Traveling companions. Hurin serves Rand loyally, calling him Lord Rand.
Owyn was Thom's nephew who could channel. Thom still feels bitterness about how Owyn was gentled and died.
Long-time friends. Zera is the innkeeper where Thom stays and speaks her mind freely to him.
Complex relationship. Moiraine was Rand's guide but he now deeply distrusts all Aes Sedai. She told him he could go where he wanted and they parted at Fal Dara.
